answer_3.quote: The LLM determines whether the idea fits an existing bucket or forms a new one. "Is x a rephrasing of any d_j ∈ D_x? Return k_j or -1." (In CoT prompting, also return a justification sentence)

answer_4.quote: Two trained research assistants (H1 and H2) independently bucketed rephrased ideas within each task. ... The dataset also includes flexibility-based Creativity Quotient scores, which we use to assess convergent validity. ... beaty18 ... includes four judges' Creative Quality ratings on a 1-5 scale ... silvia17 dataset provides three judges' Creative Quality ratings ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators followed the coding rules of Bouchard and Guilford's scoring key, assigning bucket IDs to each idea; other datasets used judges rating creative quality on Likert scales.
